findings.text: Public creation interface alloc_workqueue_noprof plus alloc_workqueue_va plus __alloc_workqueue builds a workqueue from name template plus flag set plus activity limit with variadic arguments and attaches lock tracking on success.

Device managed creation interface devm_alloc_workqueue_noprof builds a workqueue as above and registers automatic teardown via devm_workqueue_release tied to device lifetime so device release destroys the queue.
Creation variant alloc_workqueue_lockdep_map builds queue then associates caller supplied tracking object instead of initializing default tracking.

Control interface workqueue_set_max_active plus wq_clamp_max_active adjusts stored activity limit after clamping to allowed range and then rebalances effective limits while holding workqueue serialization. Deferred interrupt queues tracked by WQ_BH plus ordered queues tracked by __WQ_ORDERED refuse adjustment with warning.

Query helpers current_work plus current_is_workqueue_rescuer plus current_is_workqueue_mem_reclaim expose current execution context by returning active work item when caller runs as worker and reporting whether caller serves as rescuer or as memory reclaim context based on flags WQ_MEM_RECLAIM plus __WQ_LEGACY of owning queue.

Congestion query workqueue_congested plus busyness query work_busy report whether a given queue has inactive work on a target processor and whether a given work item is pending tracked by WORK_BUSY_PENDING or currently executing tracked by WORK_BUSY_RUNNING on its pool.

Observability helpers set_worker_desc plus print_worker_info plus wq_worker_comm allow a worker to record a descriptive label and allow external viewers to format worker identity plus current queue name plus function plus label for logs or task naming.

Diagnostic entry points show_all_workqueues plus show_freezable_workqueues plus show_one_worker_pool walk global queue list under read side protection and emit state for every busy queue and pool or for freezable queues tracked by WQ_FREEZABLE that remain busy.

System control registration workqueue_sysfs_register creates a device object tied to a queue, suppresses events until attributes are ready, exposes extra attributes when queue is unbound tracked by WQ_UNBOUND, then announces presence.

Attribute application context apply_wqattrs_ctx groups target queue pointer wq plus desired attributes pointer attrs plus batch linkage list plus default pool queue pointer dfl_pwq plus trailing variable length table pwq_tbl of pool queue pointers indexed by processor or node.
Worker pool line formatting helper pr_cont_work_struct groups separator flag comma plus function reference func plus repetition counter ctr for coalescing identical work functions during display.

Creation normalizes placement flags by converting power efficient requests tracked by WQ_POWER_EFFICIENT to unbound where enabled and by defaulting missing placement choice to per processor tracked by WQ_PERCPU while dropping per processor when combined placement choices tracked by WQ_PERCPU plus WQ_UNBOUND are present with warnings.

Creation sizes queue object larger for unbound operation tracked by WQ_UNBOUND to hold per node activity counters, initializes mutex plus counters plus list heads, links pool queues, rebalances limits, publishes on global list, optionally starts rescuer, and unwinds in reverse on failure including flushing deferred release work.

Activity limit handling assigns unlimited execution to deferred interrupt queues tracked by WQ_BH, substitutes a default tracked by WQ_DFL_ACTIVE when caller passes none, clamps into allowed interval bounded by system maximum tracked by WQ_MAX_ACTIVE with warning when out of range, and derives minimum from requested maximum bounded by system default tracked by WQ_DFL_MIN_ACTIVE while preserving saved values.

Pool queue linkage branches on queue kind with per processor expansion for bound queues, dedicated queue application for ordered queues tracked by __WQ_ORDERED with ordering check, and standard unbound attributes otherwise, freeing per processor slots and unlinking partial queues on allocation failure.

Per processor linkage allocates a pool queue for each possible processor from pool node memory, initializes association to queue and pool, links under workqueue serialization, and publishes via per processor pointer with release ordering.

Unbound affinity update skips bound or ordered queues, reuses a preallocated attribute buffer protected by hotplug exclusion, actualizes masks to allowed unbound set and target pod, compares against current pool attributes, and on mismatch installs a fresh pool queue or falls back to default queue with reference held and warning on allocation failure.

Deferred pool queue release detaches queue from parent list when linked and notes whether parent became empty, restarts oldest ordered queue when parent survives, detaches from node pending list, releases unbound pool reference when applicable, frees pool queue via read copy update, and when parent became empty schedules parent teardown with lock tracking unregistered.

Rescuer setup runs only for memory reclaim queues tracked by WQ_MEM_RECLAIM, allocates worker object, binds it to parent queue, creates kernel thread with formatted identity, binds thread affinity to unbound allowed set when overlapping active processors otherwise to possible set, then wakes thread.

Per processor pool selection chooses deferred interrupt versus regular pool array based on queue flags and then selects normal versus high priority slot within per processor storage tracked by WQ_BH plus WQ_HIGHPRI.

Congestion check normalizes unbound processor tracked by WORK_CPU_UNBOUND to current processor under preemption disabled region then tests inactive list nonemptiness via scheduler read side dereference, while busyness combines pending flag with pool locked scan for executing worker under read side protection.
Pool queue release serializes parent list removal with parent mutex, node pending removal with node counter spinlock with interrupts disabled, and unbound pool release with global pool mutex.

Unbound update and linkage paths require global pool mutex held by caller, acquire parent mutex for install or link steps, and use pool spinlock with interrupts disabled only for reference count manipulation.

Creation holds global pool mutex across linkage plus limit rebalance plus global publication plus rescuer start, nesting parent mutex for rebalance, while runtime limit adjustment holds only parent mutex.

Busyness query holds read side lock across pool lookup and pool spinlock with interrupt state saved, while congestion query disables preemption across scheduler read side dereference without pool lock.

Global diagnostics hold read side lock while walking queue list, and pool display holds pool spinlock with interrupt state saved across worker and worklist inspection while deferring log output to avoid reentry.

Worker identity formatting and processor offline handling serialize attach state with dedicated attach mutex, nesting pool spinlock with interrupts disabled for flag plus descriptor inspection, with rebind asserting attach mutex held.

Queue object moves from allocated plus attributed through linked plus rebalanced to globally visible plus rescuer equipped plus optionally exposed in system control, with failure at any stage unwinding to freed memory and success ending in explicit destruction.

Pool queue moves from linked on parent plus possibly pending on node to unlinked plus unpending plus pool released to read copy update freed, where transition where parent becomes empty triggers parent unregistration plus read copy update teardown.

Processor pool moves among bound operation, disassociated unbound operation with concurrency accounting disabled and running count cleared plus pending work kicked, and rebound operation where affinity restored at start then unbound marker tracked by WORKER_UNBOUND atomically exchanged for rebound marker tracked by WORKER_REBOUND to resume accounting on subsequent execution cycle.
Deferred release callback pwq_release_workfn serves as kernel thread work handler that owns teardown of a pool queue container derived from delivered work item via release_work member.
Device resource callback devm_workqueue_release serves as automatic teardown entry that destroys device managed queue when device releases.

Worker information printer print_worker_info runs without synchronization over a task that may be in any state and therefore copies function plus queue plus name plus description with fault tolerant reads preserving termination and emits only when some field is nonempty.

Pool display show_one_worker_pool may emit extensive output from atomic context under pool spinlock and therefore defers logging, skips fully idle pools, reports waiting duration derived from progress timestamp, and touches watchdog to avoid spurious lockup.

Affinity update plus creation paths tolerate allocation failure by warning and falling back to default pool queue or by unwinding partial linkage and flushing deferred releases before freeing, avoiding use of invalid parent when unlinked.

Overlong queue names truncate with guarded warning, deferred interrupt creation tracked by WQ_BH rejects disallowed flag combinations tracked by __WQ_BH_ALLOWS and provided limits, and limit adjustment rejects deferred interrupt plus ordered queues with warnings.

Deferred interrupt queues tracked by WQ_BH operate with effectively unlimited concurrency tracked by INT_MAX while other queues use a system default tracked by WQ_DFL_ACTIVE when unspecified and enforce lower and upper bounds defined by system limits tracked by WQ_MAX_ACTIVE with clamping and warning.

Placement and capability flags distinguish per processor tracked by WQ_PERCPU versus unbound execution tracked by WQ_UNBOUND, high priority versus normal scheduling tracked by WQ_HIGHPRI, deferred interrupt versus process context tracked by WQ_BH, memory reclaim plus freezable plus power efficient plus system visibility behaviors tracked by WQ_MEM_RECLAIM plus WQ_FREEZABLE plus WQ_POWER_EFFICIENT plus WQ_SYSFS, and ordered versus concurrent ordering tracked by __WQ_ORDERED.

Work busyness encodes pending versus running as distinct bits tracked by WORK_BUSY_PENDING plus WORK_BUSY_RUNNING combinable in returned value, and congestion is defined by nonempty inactive list, with unbound processor selection tracked by WORK_CPU_UNBOUND and unspecified node selection tracked by NUMA_NO_NODE.
